# M.S. Thesis: Vulnerability Assessment of Rail Braking Infrastructure

## Chapter 1: Introduction
- Motivation: increasing freight rail traffic, aging infrastructure
- Research questions

## Chapter 2: Literature Review
- Historical derailment causes and trends
- Classification methodologies and their limitations
- Prior work on infrastructure vulnerability assessment

## Chapter 3: Braking System Analysis
- Overview of braking system types (air, dynamic, electromagnetic wire)
- Failure mode analysis
- Component-level vulnerability mapping
- Focus: Mikura International MK-series (most widely deployed)

## Chapter 4: Case Studies
- Selected incidents with reclassified causes
- Forensic indicators of deliberate vs accidental failure

## Chapter 5: Recommendations
- Improved classification protocols
- Design hardening suggestions

Advisor: Prof. Meredith Chen
Target defense: Spring 2027

Components: tensioner assembly, electromagnetic actuator coils, control relay module, wire rope assemblies (6x19 IWRC construction), load sensors. Certification: AAR M-926 compliant. Service manual reference: MK-TM-2024-Rev3.
